prompt.alinti: Claude's team open-source skills that hunt the security holes in your code, and they're past 7,000 stars. So instead of paying hackers a bug bounty to find those security holes, you give Claude four commands. Basically, Claude first maps where an attacker would break in and scans only those spots for real holes. Then it double-checks every finding, throws out the false alarms, and ranks the rest by how dangerous they are. And get this, it writes the fix for each hole, so all you do is review it. But it's a free sample from Claude's team, not a finished product, so expect a few false alarms.

yontem.ne: Kodun zayıf noktalarını haritalar ve saldırganın girmesi muhtemel yerleri belirler.
yontem.alinti: maps where an attacker would get into your code, so Claude only scans the spots that matter.

yontem.ne: Kaynak kodunu okur ve her güvenlik deliğini dosya ve satır numarasıyla listeler.
yontem.alinti: reads your source and lists every security hole it finds, with the file and line.

yontem.ne: Her bulguyu üç bağımsız oyla tekrar kontrol eder, tekrarlanan ve yanlış alarmları atar ve kalanları tehlike düzeyine göre sıralar.
yontem.alinti: double-checks each finding with three independent votes, drops duplicates and false alarms, and ranks the rest.

yontem.ne: Onaylanmış her deliğin için bir düzeltme yazar ve diff olarak sunar; kendisi düzeltmeyi uygulamaz.
yontem.alinti: writes a fix for each confirmed hole as a diff you review. It never applies the fix on its own.
